title: UI Design Token System Compiler
description: Verifies design token spec: naming convention, alias resolution, circular reference detection, tier hierarchy enforcement

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract token taxonomy, naming convention, platform targets from brand primitives

pipeline.title: Verify Token System
pipeline.description: Run all gates: uniqueness, alias resolution, circular detection, tier hierarchy, naming convention

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed attestation artifact for downstream token consumers

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: design-token-spec.json exists and every token has name, value, type, and tier

gates.title: Tokens Unique
gates.description: Every token name is unique across the entire token set

gates.title: Alias Resolves
gates.description: Every alias reference {token.name} resolves to an existing token in the spec

gates.title: No Circular Aliases
gates.description: No circular alias chains exist in the token dependency graph

gates.title: Semantic Tokens Use Aliases
gates.description: Semantic-tier tokens must use alias references, not raw values

gates.title: Component Tokens Alias Semantic
gates.description: Component-tier tokens must alias a semantic token, not a primitive directly

gates.title: Naming Convention
gates.description: All token names follow the declared naming schema (dot-notation by default)

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in any token spec files

gates.title: Contract: Token System
gates.description: Artifact validates against token-system.contract.json: has-primitives, has-semantics, valid-types, valid-tiers

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid design token system

error_codes.UIT003: Token alias reference cannot be resolved
error_codes.UIT005: Semantic token contains raw value instead of alias reference
error_codes.UIT006: Component token aliases primitive directly (must alias semantic)
error_codes.UIT007: Token name violates naming convention schema
error_codes.UIT008: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in token spec files
